# Bhanu Mendis — bhanumendis.com

> Multi-disciplinary leader, performing artist, and audio engineer based in Colombo, Sri Lanka.

## About
Bhanu Mendis is the 2024/2025 Senior Head Prefect of Lyceum International School, Nugegoda. A qualified Sangeetha Visharadha (First Division), certified audio engineer, national champion in music and dance, and National Child Protection Ambassador.

## Key Roles
- Senior Head Prefect — Lyceum International School (2023–2025)
- Educator — The Science Brainery (2025–present)
- Audio Engineer — PEARLBAY® Holdings (2025–2026)
- Founder — Swara Concert (largest island-wide school Eastern music concert)
- Founder — Padura Concert

## Achievements
- All-Island Dancing Champion: 2018, 2019, 2023
- All-Island Music Champion: 2019, 2023, 2024
- Malaysian World Choral Competition: 1st Place
- National Chess Championship: 1st Place (2016)
